remarks: Totally renovated oversized tri-level townhouse with garage in a development of 11 townhouses. Large living room with laminate flooring leading to a deck , New eat in kitchen with quartz counter tops, stainless steel appliances with room for a table. Newly renovated full bath on second floor, heated finished lower level family room, new laminate floors throughout and laundry room. Convenient location in Springdale, walk to bus/train, restaurants. No smoking, excellent credit required, 1 car garage and 1 floating space.
